primaryEvidence.kind: public client asset for terms route
directFacts: The delivered terms asset names PROZAX SRL, registered under J35/1725/2005, at Varsovia 22–24, Timișoara.
The same asset mixes Megazone/Grand Delivery language with references to Paradisul Piraților and Aleea Studenților 4C.
Its food-order terms require the person ordering to be at least 18.
primaryEvidence.limit: HTTP asset modification is not a legal effective date. Mixed legacy wording weakens its value as evidence of current legal succession. Food-order age restriction is not a playground admission rule.

primaryEvidence.kind: current operator visitor and package data
directFacts: Megazone Kids is advertised at Strada Ion Ionescu de la Brad 15, in BEGA Lipovei; entrance is described as between DM and Sinsay.
A current visitor block advertises ages 0–8, adult accompaniment in the play area for children under 4, walk-ins with advance reservation advised, minute-based charging and free adult entry.
Published standard play package is 30 lei per child/hour; the weekday morning/early-afternoon offer is 25 lei per child/hour, Monday–Thursday 10:00–16:00.
primaryEvidence.hoursConflict: The Kids contact block says daily 10:00–21:30; footer and telephone/reservation blocks say daily 10:00–22:00. Do not publish a single closing time without resolving this conflict.
primaryEvidence.limit: This is a separately named and addressed playground. The data does not say it is the relocated original Paradisul/Tunurile attraction. Published packages and schedules are not a live capacity or same-day opening guarantee.

proposedDescription.ro: Paradisul Piraților este numele istoric al restaurantului de pe Aleea Studenților, Cantina 4C. Site-ul vechi redirecționează acum către Megazone Bites; funcționarea restaurantului inițial și a locului său de joacă nu este confirmată.
proposedDescription.en: Paradisul Piraților is the historical name of the restaurant at Aleea Studenților, Cantina 4C. Its former website now redirects to Megazone Bites; operation of the original restaurant and its playground is unconfirmed.
proposedDescription.it: Paradisul Piraților è il nome storico del ristorante in Aleea Studenților, Cantina 4C. Il vecchio sito ora rimanda a Megazone Bites; l’attività del ristorante originario e della sua area giochi non è confermata.
proposedDescription.fr: Paradisul Piraților est le nom historique du restaurant situé Aleea Studenților, Cantina 4C. Son ancien site redirige désormais vers Megazone Bites ; le fonctionnement du restaurant d’origine et de son aire de jeux reste à confirmer.
proposedDescription.es: Paradisul Piraților es el nombre histórico del restaurante de Aleea Studenților, Cantina 4C. Su antigua web ahora redirige a Megazone Bites; no está confirmado que el restaurante original y su zona de juegos sigan funcionando.
proposedDescription.zh-Hans: Paradisul Piraților 是 Aleea Studenților、Cantina 4C 餐厅的历史名称。原网站现已跳转至 Megazone Bites；原餐厅及其儿童游乐区是否仍在营业尚未确认。
